answer: A karst valley stays honest when every new identity must lower a distinct ember lamp into a distinct sinkhole and map its chambers by lamplight, while a distinct cave-warden counts each ember at the rim. The first fake owes two embers, the second four, the third eight, since the nth fake owes two to the power of n embers, so the tenth fake alone owes 1,024 embers and twenty fakes owe 2,097,150. Bulk farming fails because one lamp-bearer lights one sinkhole at a time and each ember burns in one cave only, like one miner carrying a single violet lamp down one shaft per night.
